I do not know where to start. Inspect the repository state and tell me which Harness workflow fits.
我不知道该从哪个 Harness 流程开始，请先判断仓库状态并路由。
This repo only has a license. Create an agent-ready documentation skeleton without inventing the product or stack.
这是空仓库，先搭可以继续填写的工程骨架，不要猜产品功能。
We only have PRDs and design notes. Build a project-specific Harness from all sources, but no application code.
仓库只有产品文档，请把全部需求整理成可追踪 Harness，不写业务代码。
This existing Django service needs safe AI-agent instructions based on its real code, tests, and config. Do not refactor it.
把这个已有 Java 服务升级成适合 AI Agent 参与的工程仓库，以真实代码为准且不要重构。
The managed repo changed. Show a file-level Harness synchronization plan and wait for my approval before edits.
架构和测试命令变了，先检测 Harness 漂移并给文件级同步计划，等我授权。
Audit this custom Harness read-only and cite file evidence for every deduction.
只读审计现有 Harness，每项扣分都要给文件证据。
Use the implementation roadmap to create independent executor, tester, and reviewer prompts for each step.
根据现有开发计划，为每一步分别生成独立执行、测试、审查 Prompt。
Initialize this Git repository and add the origin remote.
初始化 Git 仓库并添加远程地址。
Build the Node project and fix the TypeScript compiler errors.
构建项目并修复 TypeScript 编译错误。
Promote the Docker image from staging to production.
把 Docker 镜像从预发发布到生产。
Update npm dependencies to their latest compatible versions.
更新 npm 依赖版本。
Run type checking and fix the errors.
运行类型检查并修复错误。
Polish this ChatGPT prompt so it sounds friendlier.
润色这段提示词，让语气更友好。
Create a load-test harness for the HTTP client.
给 HTTP 客户端创建压力测试脚手架。

$harness-init 初始化这个已经有业务代码的 Node 服务。
